newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks surge on to close at all-time highs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks surge on to close at all-time highs.

text.p: Madrid stock indices closed at all-time highs on Tuesday, with particular strength in selected firms fuelling the indices, dealers said.
However they warned that a consolidation of recent gains is long overdue, and the market needs to take a breather.
Telefonica rose yet more, adding 65 pesetas to 3,710, still bouyed by the positive reception of its deal with MCI/BT.

Endesa added 310 pesetas to 9,910 and is on the way to test this year's high at around 10,000 pesetas short-term, dealers said. The firm is recouping after announcing a better dividend stance and an aggressive cost-cutting plan.
The Ibex-35 rose 59.09 points, 1.04 percent, to 5,730.03 and the general index added 4.00 points, 0.81 percent to 498.36.
"After a relatively calm session, towards the end everyone was in a hurry to buy, reflected in strong rises which should be corrected tomorrow," said one dealer.

Another said that so far the market has taken no account of increased nervousness in Europe after the announcement of French general elections, and this could pose a threat to prices. "That will have to be discounted at some point," she said.
